home.accessibleTitle: Shardee, a one-second camera and short video maker

title: Short videos,
one tap away
features.description: Quickly capture the moment you want to keep. A single tap of the shutter records a one-second video. Experience a new kind of camera that captures little moments.
features.alt: The Shardee camera recording a brief moment at a café with one tap of the shutter

title: Simple, uncluttered
editing
features.description: Leave complicated editing behind. Join your short videos together in a clean, simple interface. Creating a video is quick and easy.
features.alt: The Shardee editor selecting short videos and joining them in order

title: Your own story,
worth watching again
features.description: A trip, your adorable pet, your child growing up, a workout, or a restaurant or café you want to share. Fill your videos with the things you love, and create your own story to enjoy again and again.
features.alt: A personal video story joining moments from a meal, a walk and a trip
